617:t_027:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Is this the light of the human heart...?」

617:t_027:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's warm... Strength is welling up from deep in my heart.」

617:t_028:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ヴィルダーク$$! You can't use Earth's $$次元力$$ anymore!」

617:t_028:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「We'll bring together the strength of the Earthlings you called foolish and weak, and defeat you!」

617:t_028:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Prepare yourself, $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$! We'll free Earth from you!」

617:t_028:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「With the feelings and strength of everyone fighting!」

617:t_028:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well! It will be all of Earth against me!」

617:t_028:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I will be the victor!」

617:t_028:7.en:
$n
「We'll give you that answer right away, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

617:t_028:8.en:
$n
「And when we do, the $$新地球皇国$$ will fall! With victory for us, $c!!」

617:t_029:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「The match is over, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

617:t_029:2.en:
$$葵$$
「If you're going to call yourself a $$次元将$$, admit defeat gracefully!」

617:t_029:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Is he throwing a tantrum, like villains always do?!」

617:t_029:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「W-what the hell?! Has he lost his damn mind?!」

617:t_029:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I thank you, $c! Now I know I still have room to grow stronger!」

617:t_029:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「As thanks, I will return Earth to you!」

617:t_029:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But our real battle begins now!」

617:t_029:11.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You will meet the fundamental calamity someday! We will meet again then!」

617:t_030:0.en:
$$シオニー$$
(Farewell, $$アウストラリス$$... No, $$ヴィルダーク$$...)

617:t_030:1.en:
$$シオニー$$
(I pray that there is a future beyond your battles...)

617:t_030:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「He sounded like a sore loser, but it looks like he admitted we won.」

617:t_030:4.en:
$$桂$$
「And the Emperor himself said he'd give Earth back!」

617:t_030:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Now that the Emperor has been defeated and withdrawn from the imperial capital, the $$新地球皇国$$ has collapsed.」

617:t_031:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Reports of imperial troops withdrawing or fleeing are coming in from fronts all over the world, too.」

617:t_031:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Once they hear of their leader's defeat, the fronts still fighting will likely follow suit.」

617:t_031:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「Will they retreat to the center of the galaxy...?」

617:t_031:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「Even if they do, they may return to Earth again.」

617:t_031:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We'll deal with that when it happens! First, let's celebrate our victory!」

617:t_031:5.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「The ground forces that entered the Imperial Palace report finding the people held in the $$霊子吸収システム$$.」

617:t_031:6.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Deputy Foreign Minister $$ナナリー・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$, Representative $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$, and Princess $$マリナ・イスマイール$$ have also been confirmed safe.」

617:t_031:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(Heh... I can hear that sigh of relief even through the mask.)

617:t_031:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But we still have a mountain of problems. Some soldiers will probably keep fighting even without their leader.」

617:t_031:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「Yeah. We also have to rebuild the $$地球連邦$$.」

617:t_031:11.en:
$$ルカ$$
「There's reconstruction everywhere, starting with the infrastructure.」

617:t_031:12.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「We need to hurry up and remove the bases and $$レイライン|lc$$s all over the world, too.」

617:t_031:13.en:
$$シモン$$
「And we still don't know where the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$ they captured is.」

617:t_031:14.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「In the worst case, they may have deployed it to the front at the center of the galaxy.」

617:t_031:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And we still don't know why $$サイデリアル$$ wouldn't allow Earthlings to evolve...」

617:t_031:16.en:
$n
「So our battle with them will continue...」

617:t_031:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Um... I'm sorry to interrupt while you're basking in victory, but...」

617:t_031:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We've received word that a large $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ force has appeared at the wormhole on the edge of the $$地球圏$$.」

617:t_032:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's over, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

617:t_032:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I lost, $c! I gave it everything I had, too!」

617:t_032:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「It was the best! I don't have a single regret!」

617:t_032:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But I can't hand over this life or my $$スフィア$$ to you!」

617:t_033:0.en:
$$メール$$
「After all that cool talk, you're running away in the end!」

617:t_033:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Leave her, $$メール$$! Taking $$ラース・バビロン$$ comes first!」

617:t_033:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「First, we'll drag out the Emperor and rescue the people held in that building!」

617:t_034:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「How pathetic, $$エルーナルーナ$$. You're disgracing your title as Supreme Commander of the imperial military.」

617:t_035:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
(The time of our pact may be close, $$エルーナルーナ$$...)

617:t_036:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're still acting calm at a time like this?! You're no fun, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

617:t_036:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Even if my battle is over, our battle is not.」

617:t_037:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「He can't fight anymore. You can settle things later.」

617:t_037:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Farewell, $$尸空#pilot$$... Don't ever show me that gloomy face again.)

617:t_038:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「How disgraceful, $$尸空#pilot$$. In the end, $$鬼宿$$ was always fated to perish.」

617:t_039:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
(Bye-bye, $$尸空#pilot$$. Though we might meet again...)

617:t_040:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Why?! Why can't I beat them?!」

617:t_040:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you want to know, I'll tell you, $$バルビエル$$!」

617:t_040:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Hatred will someday burn out! Your power isn't infinite!」

617:t_040:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Shut up, $$ゼロ$$! What do you know about me?!」

617:t_040:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Because I used to be just like you.」
